description:
Hello fellow PHP developers

Neho - a digital real-estate agency in the PropTech sector, is looking for an experienced Laravel freelance developer to join our existing remote team.

Requirements:

  • Good OOP PHP knowledge and at least 5 years experience in developing PHP applications using either Laravel or another mature PHP framework
  • At least 3 years experience working on complex Laravel projects.
  • Git knowledge
  • Experience with MySQL or Postgresql
  • CI/CD knowledge (Continuous integration/Continuous development)
  • At least base knowledge on frontend integration (using Bootstrap, jQuery, React)
  • Good level of English

Nice to have:

  • Good level of French
  • Fullstack profile
  • Writing unit/functional tests using Codeception
